config.name: reputation
config.description: Risk-adjusted selection whose failure estimates come from different reputation systems: none (bid confidence only), full-history per task type, exponentially decaying, and a single global profile per agent.
config.hypothesis: Any learned reputation improves completion over no reputation when agents differ in reliability; the variants differ little from each other in a stationary market.
limitations: Agent reliability is constant within a run, so the advantage decay is designed for (adapting to agents that change) is not exercised.
